Name: Padmaster AI Assistant
Brief: Chat with your own AI assistant inside LaunchBox.
Description: This is a beta, an early test release. Padmaster AI Assistant puts a small chat panel inside LaunchBox. Ask about your games, find a manual, check which emulator a game uses, or build playlists from your library, for example every Star Wars and Star Trek game you own. Type or use the microphone. Coming next: each game's controls drawn on the controller in your hands. It uses your own AI subscription (Claude Code or Codex); the plugin stores no keys and its own server listens only on this PC, while your assistant sends what you type and what it reads to your AI provider.
Requirements: LaunchBox 14.1.x on Windows. Claude Code or Codex installed and signed in with your own subscription.
